$description: AgentOS Design System Anchor component spec — rebuilt from Ant Design community reference using AgentOS tokens

layers.name: container
layers.role: top-level auto-layout wrapper for vertical anchor items

layers.name: rail
layers.role: vertical guide line for the vertical variant

layers.name: content
layers.role: link content wrapper for label or nested content

layers.name: indicator
layers.role: active line mark for the vertical left edge

level.figmaNote: Only vertical level 1 and 2 links are kept in AgentOS.

railWidth.reason: Current foundation tokens do not define a 2px line-width token.

nestedPaddingBlock.reason: Current foundation tokens do not define a 2px vertical padding token for second-level items.

rules: Direction=Vertical → vertical rail + stacked items + nested second-level items under API

examples.vertical: <Anchor><Anchor.Link href="#basic" title="Basic demo" /><Anchor.Link href="#static" title="Static demo" /><Anchor.Link href="#api" title="API"><Anchor.Link href="#anchor-props" title="Anchor Props" /><Anchor.Link href="#link-props" title="Link Props" /></Anchor.Link></Anchor>

figmaConventions.variableMode: Never set explicit Light/Dark mode on component appearance — inherit from file or page context.
figmaConventions.pageContent: Component pages contain only component sets — no text labels, showcase matrices, doc frames, or instance grids.

componentSets.*Anchor* / Vertical: Direction=Vertical — composed variant built from *Anchor* / Link instances

figmaConventions.variantLayout: Place the atomic *Anchor* / Link set first with State columns horizontally, then place *Anchor* / Vertical as a separate composed node on the same page with no extra showcase frames.

gaps: Ant Design reference uses 14/22 text metrics; AgentOS reuses EN/Paragraph 14_h20_Regular because no local 14/22 English style is currently defined.
The community reference documents item subcomponents separately; AgentOS v1 keeps a single composed Anchor set on the page.
